value.summary: Created packages/shared/version.mjs as the single source of VERSION = "1". Updated packages/a/index.mjs and packages/b/index.mjs to import VERSION from the shared module and re-export it, keeping their info functions unchanged. One correction to the plan: a bare `export { VERSION } from ...` does not create a local binding, so the functions now use `import { VERSION } ...` plus `export { VERSION }`, which both binds locally for the template literals and preserves the public export. Behavior is unchanged: VERSION defined once, aInfo() → "a:1", bInfo() → "b:1". tests/version.test.mjs was left untouched and passes with node --test. Satisfied: single source constant, both packages re-export, no behavior change, tests green.
